_comment: UV unwrapping models of the Scenario API. Edit this file to add a model
or drop one that is gone, without touching any Python. Restart Blender
file_param is the name under which this model expects the uploaded asset
id in the request body. extra is sent verbatim. The UV models take no
other parameters, which is why there is nothing else to configure.

models.label: Hunyuan UV Unwrapping
models.description: Tencent Hunyuan UV unwrapping, the model Phototron uses. Takes no parameters
